svg.aria-label: SourceWithAI architecture: Next.js front end, Express API and Python AI services on Vultr, with MongoDB, Redis and Elasticsearch
svg.title: SourceWithAI architecture: Next.js front end, Express API and Python AI services on Vultr, with MongoDB, Redis and Elasticsearch
svg.text: Three services behind Nginx, each in the language it suits best. The system as it stood in June 2026.
VULTR · NGINX, PM2 AND DEPLOY SCRIPTS
TLS and reverse proxy in front of both services
Redis result cache, fresh for 10 minutes and served stale when a provider fails
search deadline raised to 3.5 s: a new keyword went from about 11 s to 2 to 3 s
circuit breaker on brand translation (opens on 402 or 429, one probe), Gemini as fallback
deploy scripts, Nginx configs and PM2 process checks for every service
